criteria.statement: The background download calls the loader of every other destination and not the landing one (unit test)
Every tier-2 call is made before the tier-3 card-list request (unit test)
It runs once per page load and never mounts a destination (unit test)
A rejected preload clears the cached promise and a later tap loads and shows the tool (unit test on lazyDestination)
A destination whose code has already arrived renders without the Loading fallback
A tap before the download finishes shows Loading only until the in-flight download lands, with exactly one request for that chunk
No GET /api/health is sent before the Trade Balancer opens
The production-never-preloads comments in destinationRegistry.tsx are updated
Diffs 1, 2 and 3 are applied to PRD/sections as finalized
Frontend tests and npm run quality:check pass with no coverage threshold lowered (NFR-012)
